snapshot: :root{color-scheme:light}body{margin:0;padding:24px 28px;font:12px/1.45 "IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;color:#1d1d1f;background:#fff}h1{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.06em;margin:0 0 4px;text-transform:uppercase}.meta{font:10px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;color:#55636f;letter-spacing:.04em;margin:0 0 16px;text-transform:uppercase}.meta span+span::before{content:" · "}figure{margin:0 0 14px;page-break-inside:avoid}figure svg{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}.ns{font:10px ui-monospace,monospace;border:1px dashed #5f6670;padding:3px 8px;display:inline-block;margin:0 8px 8px 0;text-transform:uppercase}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font:10px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;margin:6px 0 16px}th,td{border-bottom:1px solid #d2d2d7;padding:2px 6px;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap}th{color:#55636f;font-weight:600}td.n{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}h2{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;margin:18px 0 4px;text-transform:uppercase}footer{font:9px ui-monospace,monospace;color:#55636f;margin-top:18px;border-top:1px solid #d2d2d7;padding-top:6px;text-transform:uppercase}@page{size:A4;margin:12mm}@media print{body{padding:0}}
